name: Louisa Professional Coffee Ltd.
summary: Louisa Professional Coffee Ltd. is a Taiwanese enterprise dedicated to offering a broad spectrum of coffee and associated products. Its comprehensive menu encompasses a diverse array of beverages, including drip, specialty, and espresso coffees, alongside various teas and other refreshments. Furthermore, the company provides complementary food items such as light meals, cakes, and bagels. Customers can access their offerings through both company-owned retail establishments and franchised outlets. Founded in 2006, the company maintains its corporate headquarters in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
